# CopperLog reference

Fictional independent test reference.

CopperLog.rotateSegment performs the supported operation. The segmentBytes field selects its parameter. A full log segment is sealed and subsequent entries use a new segment. CopperLog uses this operation and field together. full log segment rotation.

Use CopperLog.rotateSegment with segmentBytes; changes become durable when the call returns. This document contains public reference information.
